title: 第1157章 惨败的黄冲霄第1156章 激将黄冲霄竞争圣女道侣
slug: 成为女帝炉鼎我踏上了无敌路
content_zh:
韩如雪从座位站起，裙裾随风轻拂，身姿缥缈出尘，黛眉微蹙，眼神复杂地望向李易。
她本以为这名凭着坚韧不拔的毅力，登临八重天梯，拜入合欢宗的老者，是沉稳隐忍、潜心求道之辈，可今日对自己的大胆告白，与对黄冲霄以及众天骄的张狂挑衅，彻底颠覆了她心中的印象。
更令她心生诧异的是。
此人指出半仙药七星草与冰寒烈阳两大法则本源的弊端，竟与她通过自身功法感知到的相差无几。
她不知这是巧合，还是对方真的身怀洞悉万物本源的异术。
无论是哪一种，都让她对其产生了一股好奇。
就在这时。
李易转身朝韩如雪拱手道：“还请圣女答应，也正好以登上天梯七重作为遴选道侣的一个条件，免得某些阿猫阿狗认为自己能配得上圣女，前来骚扰。”
此话一出。
全场瞬间炸开了锅。
原本因忌惮合欢宗威严而有所收敛的众天骄顿时破防，一个个气得额头青筋暴跳，指着李易的鼻子破口大骂：
“老匹夫你特么说谁是阿猫阿狗？”
“死老狗，你昨日不过是倚仗体内阴阳道种占了大便宜，便如此羞辱我等，想找死吗？”
“老东西，你真以为你勉强登上八重天梯，天资就举世无敌了啊，今日本神子就让你见识一下怎么踏入九重天梯的，我要你跪在地上叫爷爷……”
……
一众天骄群情激奋，眼中已燃起实质般的怒火，对李易咬牙切齿，恨不得立刻将其生吞活剥。
面对漫天怒骂，李易神色淡然，嗤笑道：
“你们对我肆意辱骂，百般威胁，我都不曾生气辩驳，此刻我不过说了句实话，便个个暴跳如雷、丑态百出，难道，真让我说中了你们的痛处？”
他声音不高，却如寒冰利刃，精准刺入众天骄心防。
广场上刹那陷入一片死寂，唯有粗重的喘息声此起彼伏。

有人面色涨红如血，有人脸色煞白，他们皆是昨日登天梯失败者，刚才嘲讽踏足八重的李易是为宣泄自己的挫败与苦闷，此时被李易一语道破真相，一时间竟不敢再开口反驳。
“韩圣女，有请即刻去看我登天梯。”
黄冲霄看向韩如雪，眼神傲慢无比，鎏金长袍猎猎作响，周身神辉暴涨，满脸不屑与张狂：
“区区八重天梯，在我貔貅帝体面前形同虚设！
今日我要冲破八重桎梏，直登九重之巅，让这井底之蛙好好看看，何为真正的天骄天资。”
“好，今日便以天梯试炼，作为我选道侣的一个条件。”
韩如雪红唇轻启，嗓音如冰玉相击，传遍全场。
她并不喜欢黄冲霄，对白齐天亦无感，也不知该怎么拒绝才好，又迫于宗门新规不得不做出选择，索性借阴阳天梯，选一个对自己修行更有利的道侣。
黄冲霄闻言，狂傲面容上霎时绽开胜券在握的笑容，声如洪钟：
“圣女放心！
今日天梯之上，我便用绝对天资证明，唯有我黄冲霄，才是你的天仙绝配，是与你阴阳相合、共登仙道的最佳道侣！”
说罢。
他率先腾空而起，朝宗门祖地大门处的阴阳天梯疾驰而去。
白齐天温润一笑，身姿轻盈浮空，气质超然出尘，淡淡开口：
“韩仙子，我们走吧。”
他姿态谦和儒雅，不骄不躁，刻意与张扬跋扈的黄冲霄形成鲜明反差，想在韩如雪心底留下一份沉稳君子气度。
韩如雪眸光淡淡扫过白齐天，并未多言，只轻轻颔首，随即转身面向高台端坐的几位同门师姐，柔和道：
“诸位师姐，请移驾天梯一观。”
话音落下。
她翩然腾空，一袭素白仙裙如飘动流云，飘然朝宗门外掠去。

白齐天、数位师姐紧随其后，并肩而行。
整片广场万千修士沸腾，纷纷御空跟上前，一时间，合欢宗玄阴峰上空流光纵横，煞是绚丽壮阔。
content_en:
Han Ruxue stood up from her seat, her skirt gently blowing in the wind, her figure ethereal and out of the dust, her eyebrows slightly frowned, and she looked at Li Yi with complicated eyes.
She originally thought that this old man who climbed the eighth level of the ladder to join the Hehuan Sect with perseverance was a calm and forbearing person who devoted himself to seeking the truth. However, today's bold confession to herself and the brazen provocation to Huang Chongxiao and other geniuses completely overturned her impression.
What surprised her even more.
This person pointed out the shortcomings of the two major principles of the semi-immortal medicine Seven Star Grass and the Ice-Cold Fierce Sun, which were actually almost the same as what she perceived through her own skills.
She didn't know if this was a coincidence, or if the other party really had the ability to understand the origin of all things.
No matter which one it was, she was curious about it.
Just then.
Li Yi turned around and cupped his hands towards Han Ruxue and said: "Please allow the saint to agree, and it just so happens that ascending the seventh level of the ladder is a condition for selecting a Taoist companion, so as to prevent some cats and dogs who think they are worthy of the saint from coming to harass you."
As soon as these words came out.
The whole place exploded instantly.
The geniuses who had restrained themselves because they were afraid of the majesty of the Hehuan Sect suddenly broke their defenses. They were so angry that veins popped out on their foreheads. They pointed at Li Yi's nose and yelled:
"Old man, who are you talking about?"
"Damn old dog, yesterday you just relied on the yin and yang in your body to take advantage of it, so you humiliated us like this. Do you want to die?"
"Old man, do you really think that your talent is unparalleled because you barely managed to climb the eighth ladder? Today, the Son of Japan will let you see how to climb the ninth ladder. I want you to kneel on the ground and call me grandpa..."
…
The geniuses were so excited that real anger was igniting in their eyes. They gritted their teeth at Li Yi and wanted to eat him alive right away.
Facing the angry curses, Li Yi looked calm and sneered:
"You insulted me wantonly and threatened me in every possible way, but I didn't even get angry and argue. Now I just told the truth, and all of them became furious and ugly. Could it be that I really hit on your point of pain?"
His voice was not loud, but it was like a sharp blade of ice, piercing the hearts of all the proud people with precision.
The square fell into a dead silence for an instant, except for the sound of heavy breathing.
Some people's faces were as red as blood, while others were as pale as white. They were all the ones who failed to climb the ladder yesterday. They just mocked Li Yi, who had stepped onto the eighth level, to vent his frustration and anguish. At this moment, Li Yi revealed the truth with one word, and for a moment he didn't dare to refute.
"Holy Lady Han, please come and see me climb the ladder to heaven immediately."
Huang Chongxiao looked at Han Ruxue, his eyes were extremely arrogant, his gilt robes made a hunting sound, his whole body glowed sharply, his face was filled with disdain and arrogance:
"A mere eighth-level ladder to heaven is useless in front of my Emperor Pixiu body!
Today I want to break through the shackles of the eighth level and go straight to the top of the ninth level, so that this frog in the well can take a good look at what true talent is. "
"Okay, today I will use the Heavenly Ladder Trial as a condition for me to choose a Taoist partner."
Han Ruxue's red lips parted slightly, and her voice was like ice jade hitting each other, spreading throughout the audience.
She didn't like Huang Chongxiao, and she had no feelings for Bai Qitian, and she didn't know how to refuse him. She was forced to make a choice due to the new rules of the sect, so she simply used the Yin-Yang Ladder to choose a Taoist companion who was more beneficial to her practice.
Upon hearing this, Huang Chongxiao's arrogant face instantly revealed a smile that showed he was sure of victory, and his voice was like a loud bell:
"Saint, don't worry!
Today on the ladder to heaven, I will use my absolute talent to prove that only I, Huang Chongxiao, am your perfect match as an immortal, and the best Taoist companion who can harmonize with your yin and yang and ascend the immortal path together! "
Say it.
He took the lead to rise into the air and galloped towards the Yin-Yang ladder at the gate of the sect's ancestral land.
Bai Qitian smiled warmly, with a light and airy figure and an aloof temperament, and said lightly:
"Fairy Han, let's go."
His posture is modest and elegant, neither arrogant nor impatient. He deliberately forms a sharp contrast with the domineering Huang Chongxiao, hoping to leave a calm gentleman's demeanor in Han Ruxue's heart.
Han Ruxue's eyes were lightHe glanced at Bai Qitian and didn't say much. He just nodded lightly, then turned to face the fellow senior sisters sitting on the high platform and said softly:
"Senior sisters, please move up the ladder to take a look."
The words fell.
She soared into the air, wearing a plain white fairy dress, and flew towards the outside of the sect like floating clouds.
Bai Qitian and several senior sisters followed closely, walking side by side.
Thousands of monks in the whole square were excited, and they all came forward from the sky. For a moment, the sky above Hehuan Sect Xuanyin Peak was filled with light, which was really gorgeous and magnificent.
